summary: This clinical trial is testing a study drug called RO7204239 compared to a placebo, which is an inactive substance, in people with type 2 diabetes mellitus and overweight or obesity. Insulin sensitivity means how well your body's cells respond to insulin, a hormone that helps control blood sugar levels. Researchers want to see how the study drug affects insulin sensitivity and muscle composition over time. The study is a Phase 1 clinical trial sponsored by Hoffmann-La Roche with 30 participants.
